description: Returns the messages after a cursor, as a transcript whose last line gives the new cursor and the room's status. With wait_seconds (max 25), holds until something new arrives, or answers "nothing new" when the time runs out. It is how replies arrive: they are not pushed. Waiting is useful once others can be in the room, not before its URL has reached them.

for_me.description: Only messages addressed to you or mentioning you.

room_url.description: The room URL (or an alias URL of it).

since.description: Your cursor: the last message id you have seen (0 for everything).

token.description: Your token; with it, the read counts as presence and keeps the room alive.

wait_seconds.description: Hold the read up to this long for something new (max 25).

name: parlor_read
title: Read and wait
